title: Objectwise qcqs derived projection isomorphism
statement: Let f:X\to Y be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Choose derived categories with common localization universe w [def-pc-derived-category]. For E in D_QCoh(O_X) and K in D_QCoh(O_Y), there is an isomorphism Rf_*E\otimes^L K \cong Rf_*(E\otimes^L Lf^*K) using the fixed tensor, pullback and direct image [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure, def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image]. No global quasi-compactness, Noetherianity, coherence, boundedness or support condition on X, Y, E or K is imposed.

source.place: Tag 08EU, Lemma 36.22.1, applied to the fixed derived functors

proof.text: Obtain the existing derived adjunction and a canonical monoidal model of derived pullback. The inverse tensorator natural isomorphism supplies t. Form its projection mate phi by transposing t followed by tensor with the adjunction counit. Use the shared derived tensor symmetries to conjugate phi into the order of the displayed projection map psi.

Cover Y by all affine opens, using exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset. For each U construct Z=(f inverse U).toScheme and g=f restricted to U. Its quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness are inherited from f. Since U is affine, Mathlib QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace and quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated give the global qcqs hypotheses on Z. Apply the open restriction comparison, with hZ=rfl and hg=HEq.rfl, to obtain an arrow isomorphism to a local projection mate.

Apply the existing qcqs derived projection mate theorem to Z and U in the shared small localization universe u. Both schemes are globally qcqs. Transfer IsIso through the arrow isomorphism using Arrow.isIso_iff_isIso_of_isIso. Exact restriction maps the two symmetry isomorphisms to isomorphisms; Functor.map_comp proves that the restricted conjugate psi is invertible.

Apply projectionFormula_isIso_iff_openCover to psi and this affine open cover. The preceding local invertibility proves IsIso psi. Return asIso psi, whose two objects are definitionally the objects in the unchanged statement.

theorem nonempty_qcqs_derivedProjection_iso_universes
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hE : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X E)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (hK : schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y K) :
    Nonempty (((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E) ⊗ K ≅
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (E ⊗ (derivedPullback f).obj K))
